    About Papers

    Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

    Your portfolio includes:

    • Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

    • Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

    • Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

    As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

    Your role

    We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

    Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

    If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

    Success Metrics (First 90 Days)

    • 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

    • 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

    • 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

    Core Responsibilities

    1. Storytelling That Converts

    • Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

    • Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

    • Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

    • Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

    2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution

    • Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

    • Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

    • Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

    3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA

    • Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

    • Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

    • Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

    • Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

    4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops

    • Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

    • Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

    • Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

    • Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

    What We Are Looking For

    Essential Experience & Qualifications

    • 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

    • Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

    • Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

    • Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools.

    • Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably.

    • CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho.

    Preferred Technical Skills

    • Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations

    Mindset & Soft Skills

    • Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

    • Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning.

    • Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment.

    Working Environment & Expectations

    • Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast.

    • Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win.

    • Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively.

    Why join Papers?

    • Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means.

    • High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes.

    • Influence the Growth strategy from day one.

    • Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth.

    • 25 days paid vacation per year.

.

FMA - Freitaler Metall- und Anlagenbau GmbH · Poststr. 23 · 01705 Freital

Deine Mission:

In der FMA-Freitaler- Metall- und Anlagenbau GmbH trägst du in der Anarbeitung eine zentrale Verantwortung dafür, dass aus Rohmaterial präzise gefertigte Stahlbauteile entstehen, die die Grundlage für unsere gesamte Schweißbaugruppenfertigung bilden.     Verantwortung für die gesamte operative Vorfertigung in der Anarbeitung als Grundlage für die Schweißbaugruppenfertigung. Dabei arbeitest du aktiv in der Bearbeitung von Stahlbauteilen mit und stellst sicher, dass Qualität, Maßhaltigkeit und Prozessvorgaben eingehalten werden.

Win new restaurants across Germany and help build one of our fastest-growing markets from the ground up.

About SOUS

SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.

Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.

We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa.

    Sunday creates pocket-sized friends for the mass market. We turn idle moments into meaningful connections for millions of users worldwide.

    Sunday focuses on the psychology of care, companionship, and empathy. We build accessible worlds where players don't just solve puzzles, they rescue friends. By combining mass-market accessibility with deep emotional hooks, we are defining the next era of digital entertainment.

    As Engineering Manager, you will lead Sunday's engineering team of approximately ten engineers across Unity game development and SDK. The position reports to the Director of Operations and works in close partnership with Production, Product, and Growth.

    The role combines people leadership with technical ownership. Your primary responsibility is to lead and develop the team and to define how engineering operates. At the same time, you remain close enough to the code to own architectural decisions, review critical work and contribute directly where this supports delivery.

    Our team delivers frequent releases across a portfolio of live games. We are looking for a leader who understands the trade-offs between quality, time and budget in the context of business priorities, and who translates them into sound technical decisions and the management of the team. This includes making our delivery pace sustainable through stable releases, a well-maintained codebase and engineering practices that scale with the business. The role carries a clear mandate to shape how engineering works at Sunday.

    What you will own

    • People leadership: development plans, performance conversations against clear role expectations, hiring and onboarding. You hold conversations early and directly.

    Who we are

    Why this role, why now

    Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts (arXiv 2604.20246). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them.

    The Real-World Learning Loop is your system

    Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” (The Real-World Learning Loop, Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise:

    • In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning.

    • Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You decide what is worth recording and which situations the fleet should go and find.

    • Data Curation and Learning. Novelty, uncertainty, failures and distribution shift decide what we learn from. You own the curation and the training recipe.

    • Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. You set the bar, and how fast we can clear it safely.

    Every deployment teaches the next one. Your job is to make that loop turn faster and teach more each time.

    • Own the compute strategy, from large-scale training to real-time inference on the robot.

    • Be Sereact’s scientific voice with customers, partners, universities and investors, and build academic partnerships.

    • Partner with the CTO, product and operations, so research, engineering and deployment pull in one direction.

    • A research lab beside the business. Research at Sereact ends on a robot, ideally at a customer.

    • Product roadmap and pricing.

    What makes this role hard

    • Research and production compete for the same robots, people and compute. You make that trade-off every week, in the open.

    • Cortex is not a blank page. It already runs in customer operations, and our founders are deeply technical. You raise the ceiling of a running system.

    3. How do you decide what to publish and what to keep?

    • Teams in Stuttgart, Zurich and Boston; relocation support.

    About Numan 
     
    Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
     
    Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
     
    To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: 
     
    • Patients first.
    • Learn fast.
    • Own the quality.
    • Succeed together.
    • Care deeply.
     
    Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

    The Role: 

    This is a high-impact data role supporting a complex and fast-paced operations function, reporting to the Director of  Analytics & Data . You’ll be the analytics partner for Numan’s clinical operations, customer care, and health coaching teams, as well as our pharmacy and fulfilment centre.

    These teams run on numbers. How long a patient waits for their prescription to be approved, or for a reply from a customer care agent. Whether there are enough coaches for the patients waiting. How many orders leave the pharmacy on time, and whether the stock is there to fill them. When a process changes, you’ll build the metrics that measure it and make sure the teams can trust them.

    You’ll be the custodian of those metrics end to end, from the dbt models in BigQuery to the Looker dashboards the teams open every morning. Some are live queues the teams use to divert resources during the day; others feed the weekly business reviews and longer-term planning.

     

    You will:

  • Be the analytics partner for clinical operations, customer care, health coaching and the pharmacy and fulfilment centre, balancing each of their priorities and communicating timelines clearly. You’ll sit in their meetings and Slack channels, and be the first person they ask when questioning a number.

  • Build and maintain the operations data models in dbt on BigQuery, and the Looker views, explores and dashboards on top of them.

  • Be responsible for the surfacing of the 100+ metrics the operations teams report on (wait times and SLAs, per-hour productivity, audit scores, on-time dispatch, stock cover) and keep a written definition for each one.

  • Help the teams build their demand forecasts and capacity plans, so the business knows how many people it needs and when.

  • Explain why metrics move. Work out whether a change is real or can be explained by mix, reporting lag or a tracking problem, then find the cause and tell the team what to do about it.

  • Help operations managers set targets and SLAs from a measured baseline, then track performance against them.

  • Track the patient journey from checkout through prescription approval to first delivery, identifying where patients wait or drop out during the onboarding journey.

  • Help the teams answer their own questions: walk new managers through their dashboards and explain what each metric means.

  • Work with data engineering to model new data sources, and fix data quality problems when they show up.

  • Occasionally support the commercial and finance teams with ad hoc analysis.

  • Treat patient data with care. You’ll work with special category health data, so you’ll report in aggregate and follow UK GDPR.


    • You'll need:

    Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en évaluation de la vulnérabilité d’un réseau d’accès Télécom de type PON (Passive Optical Network) vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS (Distributed Acoustic Sensor) pour rejoindre le département Communications et Electronique (COMELEC).

     La mesure de vibrations acoustiques distribuées par fibre optique (DAS, Distributed Acoustic Sensing) est une technologie récente, dont les applications ne cessent de se diversifier. On peut citer par exemple la détection d’intrusion en surveillance périmétrique, les mesures sismiques, le diagnostic de puits (pétrole, géothermie), etc. La bande passante de la mesure, de sub-Hertz à la centaine de kiloHertz, permet également d’envisager la captation de la bande audio, et donc de réaliser des mesures audios sur une fibre optique. Il est ainsi possible d’utiliser le réseau optique télécom d’un bâtiment pour réaliser des écoutes, en utilisant un système DAS modifié, intégrant des artéfacts matériels particuliers (enroulement, antennes, connecteurs) au voisinage de la zone d’écoute et un traitement du signal spécifique pour obtenir des performances suffisantes.

    Le cadre de ce Postdoc est d’évaluer la vulnérabilité d’un réseau télécom vis-à-vis d’écoutes potentielles par DAS. Le branchement sur un réseau optique Telecom local en fonctionnement nécessite de s’adapter à son architecture, notamment en termes de plan de longueur d’onde.

    L’audit des systèmes de télécommunication afin d’en évaluer la vulnérabilité constitue un enjeu majeur du réseau télécom. Un exemple de configuration d’un réseau d’accès est décrit dans la figure ci-après. Depuis le réseau Backbone, à partir du ‘Central Office’, les signaux télécoms sont acheminés chez les abonnés via le PON (Passive Optical Network). À l’intérieur des bâtiments, un réseau FTTX (Fiber To The X=H home, X=R room, X=O office, etc) ou un réseau local LAN (Local Area Network) optique servent respectivement à acheminer le signal optique jusqu’au terminal final ou à communiquer entre deux terminaux locaux via une liaison optique. Le PON comprend une fibre nourricière (Feeder Fiber) puis, au moins, un coupleur 1×N. Le codage de l’information est alors un mélange de multiplexage en longueur d’onde grossier (C-WDM) et de multiplexage temporel (TDM). Chaque voie de sortie du coupleur 1×N est envoyée vers des groupes de 1 à n abonnés à travers, au moins, un filtre qui sélectionne la longueur d’onde qui leur est allouée. Le signal après ce filtre est alors monochromatique et codé TDM. Le dernier coupleur 1×n répartie le signal chez les n abonnés. Ce PON comprend donc, entre autres, des coupleurs passifs qui divisent les signaux vers différents abonnés mais aussi des connecteurs, soudures, etc.

    L’objectif de ce Postdoc est de faire un état des lieux des différents types de réseau mis en place et d’en évaluer les conséquences sur la capacité de mesures DAS :

    ·         Description des différents types de réseaux locaux existants,

    ·         Etats des lieux des différents types de transmission : CWDM, TDM, …

    ·         Quels sont les différents points d’accès pour une mesure DAS ?

    ·         Comment discriminer les différentes fibres interrogées après un coupleur ? Influence des points réflecteurs,

    ·         Etude des différentes marges de puissance pour une mesure DAS,

    ·         Potentielle présence de nœuds d’insertion et limite de la transparence optique,

    ·         Sensibilité des mesures DAS en fonction des différents types de fibre et de leur environnement,

    ·         Influence du réflecteur final sur la capacité d’écoute.

    Le caractère innovant sera la définition des conditions du réseau et des configurations et des performances DAS permettant un audit cyber sur des infrastructures déjà déployées.

        • Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality.

        • Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams.

        • Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts.

        • Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios.

        • Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person.

        Waarom deze rol bestaat

        De meeste AI-projecten halen productie nooit. Zes maanden verder, budget verdubbeld, scope gehalveerd, en wat er ligt is een presentatie in plaats van software die eindgebruikers omarmen.

        Wij doen het anders. Een werkende POC in zeven dagen, op echte data van de klant. Daarna in weken naar productie. Die belofte houdt alleen stand als de mensen die hem waarmaken scherp zijn.

        Met agentic coding tools zoals Claude Code en Codex komt er sneller iets werkends uit dan ooit. Daardoor verschuift het werk van bouwen naar regie voeren. De vraag achterhalen, de juiste oplossing ontwerpen, AI en engineering slim inzetten, en de kwaliteit bewaken. Daarom zoeken we iemand die tussen developer en consultant in zit. Technisch sterk genoeg om zelf te bouwen en te beoordelen of iets deugt, sterk genoeg aan de voorkant om de vraag achter de vraag te vinden, en verantwoordelijk tot het live staat en live blijft.

        AI schrijft bij ons veel. Verantwoordelijkheid kun je niet uitbesteden. Alles wat jouw naam draagt, heb je zelf gelezen, gecontroleerd en begrepen voordat het de deur uitgaat.

        Taken

        Er zijn twee manieren waarop onze klanten bij ons bouwen, en jij doet ze allebei.

        Wij bouwen

        Een klant stapt binnen met een proof of concept. Zeven dagen, een scherp gekaderde scope.

        Jij ownt die POC. Jij vraagt uit wat er echt nodig is, jij bepaalt wat er wel en niet in gaat, jij bouwt hem op hun echte data, en jij neemt de klant stap voor stap mee in de demo. Daarna bouw je het in weken uit tot MVP. Vanaf dat moment doe je het niet meer alleen. Je haalt je team erbij, neemt ze mee in wat het moet worden en bouwt samen verder. Vervolgens maak je het productieklaar, met auth, monitoring en CI/CD. Jij blijft er eigenaar van.

        De klant bouwt, wij borgen

        Bij een groeiend deel van onze klanten bouwt hun eigen team met Claude Code, Codex en Cursor. Wij reviewen elke pull request, tekenen elke release en zetten de productieomgeving op, volgens onze standaarden en zonder dat ze erop hoeven wachten.

        Daar is je rol anders. Je zit bij hun product owners, delivery lead en developers aan tafel, je kijkt kritisch mee met wat ze maken, en jij borgt dat het veilig en productiewaardig live komt. Je bouwt minder zelf en je beoordeelt meer. Dat vraagt dat je kunt uitleggen waarom iets niet deugt zonder dat iemand zich aangevallen voelt, en dat je ze in gewone taal meeneemt in hoe het wel hoort.

        Je hebt je eigen klantportfolio en bent hun aanspreekpunt binnen SevenLab. Je begeleidt discovery sessies en workshops om tot richting en prioriteiten te komen, en je schat in wat je zelf doet, wat je samen oppakt en wanneer een specialist moet aanhaken.

        Vereisten

        Must have

        • meerdere jaren ervaring met het bouwen van webapplicaties of softwareproducten;
        • je hebt zelf software naar productie gebracht die nu live draait en door klanten wordt gebruikt, en je kunt het laten zien;
        • je kunt in een week in je eentje iets werkends neerzetten op echte data, en je weet wat je bewust buiten scope houdt om dat te halen;
        • je hebt eerder in een rol gezeten waarin techniek en klantcontact samenkwamen, en je kunt een klantgesprek leiden en de vraag achter de vraag vinden;
        • je bent kritisch op codekwaliteit, structuur, testbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid, ook bij code die een AI-tool oplevert. Niets gaat langs jou zonder dat je het hebt getest en beoordeeld;
        • je kunt iets veilig live zetten en live houden: deployment, monitoring, security, en weten wat je doet als het misgaat;
        • je denkt in systemen. Kom je iets voor de derde keer tegen, dan los je het niet voor de derde keer op. Dan bouw je iets zodat het niet meer gebeurt;
        • je zoekt het eerst zelf uit in de documentatie, de code en de logs. Blijft er een vraag over, dan stel je hem met een hypothese erbij zodat de ander in één keer kan antwoorden;
        • je zet vaagheid om in richting, structuur en resultaat;
        • je communiceert scherp: je legt technische keuzes uit aan mensen zonder technische achtergrond, en je geeft feedback op andermans werk zodat ze er wat mee kunnen;
        • professioneel Nederlands en Engels, gesproken en geschreven.

        Nice to have

        • ervaring met release-governance als specialisme: approvals, signing, rollback;
        • ervaring in gereguleerde sectoren zoals zorg of de publieke sector;
        • open source bijdragen op je naam.

        Voor wie dit is

        • je wil eigenaar zijn van het hele traject, van eerste gesprek tot wat er live staat, en je vindt het prettig dat het jouw naam is die eraan hangt;
        • snel en goed zijn bij jou geen tegenpolen. Je haalt dat door scope scherp te houden en te weten waar je niet op moet inkorten;
        • je wil voorop lopen, probeert nieuwe dingen uit en wil beter worden dan je gisteren was;
        • je denkt verder dan "kunnen we dit bouwen". Je vraagt je ook af wat het oplevert en wat de slimste route is;
        • als er iets stukgaat, ben jij degene die het meldt voordat iemand het vraagt.

        Voor wie dit niet is

        • de developer die het liefst de hele dag in zijn editor zit en klantcontact vermijdt;
        • de consultant die adviseert wat een klant moet bouwen en daarna weg is. Wij zijn verantwoordelijk tot en met productie;
        • iemand die veel prototypes maakt die daarna blijven liggen;
        • iemand die de output van een chatbot doorstuurt zonder hem zelf te lezen. AI gebruiken doen we allemaal, de hele dag. Het ongelezen doorgeven van wat eruit komt is iets anders;
        • iemand die een vraag bij een ander neerlegt voordat hij de documentatie heeft opengeslagen of zelf heeft getest.

        Waar je mee werkt

        Fullstack JavaScript en TypeScript, Vue en Nuxt, PostgreSQL en Drizzle, Claude Code en vergelijkbare agentic tooling, CI/CD, monitoring. We draaien op NVIDIA-infrastructuur en op Scaleway voor Europese data-residency. We zijn ISO 27001-gecertificeerd en onze klanten zitten in sectoren waar dat niet vrijblijvend is.

        Benefits

        • een team van sterke specialisten waarmee je kunt sparren en waar je op kunt leunen wanneer iets dieper of complexer wordt;

        • een omgeving waarin snelheid, kwaliteit en innovatie samenkomen.

        Na je sollicitatie plannen we eerst een korte remote kennismaking. Daarna volgt een gesprek op kantoor met een praktische case of assessment.

        In die case bepaal jij wat je zou uitvragen, wat je in en buiten scope zet om het af te krijgen, wat er niet deugt aan wat er ligt, en wat er moet gebeuren voordat dit veilig live kan. Je mag AI gebruiken zoveel je wil. We kijken ook naar de vragen die je ons stelt.

        Beschrijf iets dat je hebt gebouwd met AI en live hebt gezet, en dat daarna een serieus probleem bleek te hebben. Hoe kwam je erachter, wat deed je eraan, en hoe zorgde je dat het niet nog een keer kon gebeuren?

", "company_logo_url": "https://remotive.com/job/2091161/logo"}, {"id": 2091158, "url": "https://remotive.com/remote-jobs/software-development/software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-2091158", "title": "Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks", "company_name": "Askable", "company_logo": "https://remotive.com/job/2091158/logo", "category": "Software Development", "tags": ["C++", "docker", "git", "go", "java", "python", "security", "AI/ML", "rust", "Typescript ", "distributed systems", "SOLID", "Linux/Unix", "testing", "infrastructure"], "job_type": "contract", "publication_date": "2026-10-17T16:04:29", "candidate_required_location": "Worldwide", "salary": "$1000 per task", "description": "

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Where do you belong?

Your career is more than just a job, it's part of your life. Whether you’re a clinician, or non-clinical professional, at USACS you'll feel a sense of connection working with clinicians and office staff who share your interests and values. We want you to love coming to work each day because you believe in what you do and the people with whom you work. We care about your success.

USACS also understands that location is important. We offer career opportunities for clinicians and non-clinical support staff from New York to Hawaii and numerous points in between. Our supportive culture, outstanding benefits and competitive compensation package is best in class.

Job Description

The Clinician Scheduler develops and manages schedules for clinicians at hospital locations to ensure that all shifts are fully staffed for the expected patient volume. This role will work with Clinicians, Leadership, and Site Directors to ensure appropriate clinician coverage is in place to treat expected patient volumes. The clinician scheduler contributes to the corporation’s financial performance by managing schedules based on tiered prioritization of clinician utilization, optimizing clinician availability, assisting in requesting and planning future over/under staffing needs, and adjusting as needed on a continual basis.

Location: Remote


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Creates and maintains schedules for multiple hospital locations 45 days before the start of the month.
  • Works independently utilizing scheduling software (Shift Admin) to auto-generate schedules based on customizations, rules, and weightings.
  • Establish relationships with all providers to learn their scheduling preferences and hard stops. Use discretion to determine reasonable asks and when medical director approval/denial is necessary.
  • Analyze requests, identify potential conflict areas, and determine the best solution. If unsuccessful in resolving independently, implement an escalation process.
  • Compile standard reports based on historical data to determine future staffing needs.
  • Collaborate with credentialing, RDO, Directors, or others to ensure available staffing.
  • Work with other clinician schedulers to ensure coordination of the utilization of cross-credentialed providers and days of availability.
  • Work with Scheduling Optimization to schedule traveling physicians and to optimize the site allocation process.
  • Ensure distributed days of availability allow for complete staffing of all shifts. Optimize trades and shift blocking to minimize costs of traveling physician expenses.
  • Responsible for ensuring continuity of care, shift equity, and distribution in accordance with site-specific scheduling policies.
  • Schedule providers based on budgeting tiers. Maximize the use of local FT clinicians based on contractual obligations, followed by PT, STAT, and locums in descending priority.
  • Responsible for coordinating and securing the use of outside clinician resources through locum companies within budgeted goals as necessary to complete the schedule.
  • Modification of shift maps as directed by site leadership
  • Work with the President/VP/Site Directors/RDOs to adjust the schedule for service/budget under immediate deadlines.
  • Work directly with site Physician/APP leaders to ensure optimal schedules before publication.
  • Responsible for ensuring anticipated and last-minute open shifts are filled. Responsible for communicating changes to schedule and providing all necessary parties are aware and in agreement.
  • Responsible for maintaining provider satisfaction regarding the monthly schedule. Ensures expectations are clear of clinician scheduling requirements and expectations from scheduling.
  • Ability to investigate the source of any complaints, analyze the underlying reasons, and resolve them as appropriate.
  • Responsible for setting up Shift Admin and properly applying shifts with pay codes to automate payroll through Workday integration.
  • Utilize strong judgment when deviations from established policies and procedures are necessary to complete schedules based on established deadlines.
  • Communicates terms and premium rates with providers to ensure all shifts are covered after the provider is scheduled to contract max by site leadership.
  • On Call responsibilities may be required.
  • Discretion in the escalation process when clinician leadership support is necessary to create a schedule effectively.
  • Responsible for ensuring all parties agree with scheduling policies and decisions surrounding specific issues, including local and support clinician leadership.
  • Analyze metrics and reporting, able to communicate results

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Ability to navigate and function under a dual and remote reporting structure
  • Strong organization and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to prioritize competing needs
  • Uses critical thinking skills to make decisions
  • Professional presentation/phone savvy
  • High-level analytics skills
  • Ability to effectively perform in a multi-task work environment
  • Ability to maintain patience and composure in difficult situations
  • Ability to identify and communicate emerging issues to management
  • Knowledge and skills in using personal computers (Windows) with a strong emphasis on Microsoft Office
  • Programs- Outlook, Word, Excel and Adobe Acrobat
  • Technical ability with scheduling software

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Experience creating/managing complex fluid schedules
  • Shift admin scheduling experience preferred
  • Previous experience working with clinicians preferred

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • This position requires long periods of sitting and reviewing data on computer monitors
  • Required to have close visual acuity to perform the job

Hourly Rate: $21.59-$39.94

Hourly rate may be determined on several factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills, experience, education, geographical location and requirements stated in job description.

The Impact Finance & Markets division at The Nature Conservancy (TNC) provides technical and strategic leadership to create transformational impact with the private sector by translating the value of nature and conservation approaches into actionable, science-based strategies to help solve societal challenges. The Finance Manager, Impact Finance and Markets (IFM) will provide highly specialized finance/accounting-related services for business units within the Division.


This recruitment will fill two positions within the Impact Finance and Markets Division. One will support the Global Carbon Markets team, and the other will support the Global Corporate Engagement team. The Global Carbon Markets team is dedicated to achieving high environmental and climate integrity across its carbon project portfolio while advancing new Natural Climate Solutions (NCS) pathways. The Corporate Engagement team provides technical leadership to translate the value of nature and conservation into actionable and standards-aligned strategies for companies across the world. The recruitment process will occur simultaneously for both positions.


The Finance Manager will report to the Director of Finance, Impact Finance and Markets.


The preferred location for this position is anywhere within the U.S. This position has the option to be remote, hybrid, or working from a TNC office if one is readily available in the candidate’s location.


Current TNC employees that are interested from Canada and LAR will also be considered.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


The Finance Manager provides advanced financial planning, reporting, analysis, compliance and operational finance support for their assigned finance portfolio. The role serves as an experienced finance resource, independently managing complex financial activities, supporting decision-making through analysis and insight, and ensuring the integrity, and compliance of financial data, processes, and controls.

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

  • Leads budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, financial close, and related financial management activities for an assigned function, portfolio, program, or organizational area.
  • Provides financial analysis, reporting, modeling and decision support insights to inform planning, resource allocation and operational decision-making.
  • Maintains the accuracy, integrity, and effective administration of financial data, systems, processes and internal controls.
  • Supports implementation of financial strategies, operational improvements, organizational initiatives, and finance process enhancements.
  • Leads development and tracking of project budgets.
  • Leads on grants management and financial donor reporting.
  • Monitors compliance with TNC policies, financial controls, and applicable legal and regulatory. requirements; identifies and escalates potential issues.
  • Supports on expense report/invoice approvals and submission of journal entries.
  • Administers or supports specialized finance processes, programs, projects, funding portfolios, contracts, or operational activities relevant to assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Provides technical guidance and support to colleagues and stakeholders and may coordinate work or training for other finance staff.
  • May participate in complex negotiations.
  • Exemplifies TNC’s Values and Code of Conduct and leads by example.

We’re Looking for You:


Are you looking for work you can believe in? At TNC we strive to embody a philosophy of Work that You Can Believe in where you can feel like you are making a difference every day. We’re looking for someone with strong experience in leading a diverse, multi-disciplinary team. The ideal candidate should have exceptional communication and collaboration skills and experience in management of controls and reports of a business unit. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the ongoing mission of conservation by directing and shaping the work of our team!


What You’ll Bring:


  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field and 4 years' related experience or equivalent combination.
  • Experience creating and managing project or organizational budgets in Excel or other similar software.
  • Experience managing multiple priorities and stakeholders in a complex, highly matrixed environment.
  • Technical experience with grants management.
  • Experience using accounting and financial reporting systems.
  • Fluency in English.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to influence, communicate effectively, and collaborate across cultures and geographies.
  • Excellent analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Experience working with Workday for financial management is preferred but not required.
  • Non-profit accounting experience preferred.
  • Experience in manipulating, analyzing and interpreting data. Strong expertise in Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • MBA or CPA is a bonus but not required.
  • Multi-cultural experience appreciated.

Salary Information:

This position may be based in any country where TNC has an established entity, taking into consideration legal restrictions, such as non-national ratios and immigration processing times. For U.S. based applicants only, the starting pay range for this position is generally within the range of $69,000 – $110,000 for annual base salary and is based on location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA.


For all other applicants, pay ranges will be in local currency, the pay range will be based on the local labor market, and not tied to the above pay range. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment and used to determine your actual pay range. Additionally, for all applicants, actual pay will fall within a range based on a variety of factors including, for example, the candidate’s qualifications, specific skills, and experience.


Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Submittal Clerk

  • Work Type: Full-time.

  • Schedule: Standard US business hours, with occasional overtime and weekend work required based on bid schedules and workload demands.

  • Location: 100% Remote.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and specialized administrative professional to serve as a Submittal Clerk. Operating in the critical space between pre-construction and operations, you will be responsible for generating, organizing, and tracking technical product data and comprehensive submittal packages. By meticulously managing the technical document approval process, you will prevent ordering delays and ensure that all proposed materials match project specifications and receive design team approval prior to procurement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Specification Review: Review project specifications and contract documents to precisely identify all required submittals, LEED documentation, warranties, and closeout requirements.

  • Package Assembly: Gather product data sheets, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), color charts, and testing data from manufacturers to assemble comprehensive and accurate submittal packages.

  • Tracking & Follow-Up: Log all outgoing submittals, rigorously track review times, and follow up proactively with General Contractors (GCs) or Architects regarding "Revise and Resubmit" or "Approved as Noted" statuses.

  • Internal Distribution: Distribute approved submittals to the project management and purchasing teams to facilitate accurate, timely material ordering.

  • Project Closeout: Assist in compiling Operations and Maintenance (O&M) manuals and warranty documentation at project completion.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: 1–3 years of professional experience in construction administration, document control, or project engineering.

  • Technical Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to read and navigate construction specifications (specifically Division 7 and Division 8). Familiarity with construction management software (e.g., Procore) for executing submittal workflows.

  • Core Competencies: High attention to detail, accuracy, and rigorous documentation practices. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Must be able to pass a pre-employment screening.

  • Remote Infrastructure: Must have a dedicated, noise-free home office setup equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a backup power source.

Benefits of Working for Hyre

  • Performance-based raises.

  • Minimum 5 days off annually (paid or unpaid based on client terms).

  • Annual cost-of-living adjustments at your one-year anniversary.

The Integration/Middleware Engineer provides advanced technical engineering support for CLIENT's enterprise integration platforms, middleware environments, API management services, and data pipeline infrastructure. This individual brings deep integration engineering expertise to the design, build, operation, and sustainment of CLIENT's enterprise integration environment.

This role is focused specifically on integration engineering and middleware platform operations — the technical discipline of connecting enterprise systems, automating data flows, managing APIs, and ensuring reliable, secure, and performant integration services across CLIENT's on-premises and cloud application portfolio. The Integration / Middleware Engineer works at the platform and architecture level, designing and building integration solutions that enable CLIENT's enterprise applications to communicate and operate effectively as a cohesive enterprise environment.

This individual must demonstrate deep hands-on expertise in enterprise integration platforms, middleware technologies, API management, and data pipeline engineering, with the ability to independently design, build, and troubleshoot complex integrations in a federal enterprise environment that spans on-premises infrastructure, AWS, and Microsoft Azure Government.

Key Responsibilities:

Integration Platform Engineering & Operations:

  • Design, build, configure, and maintain CLIENT's enterprise integration platform and middleware environments, ensuring reliable, secure, and well-performing data flows and system integrations
  • Engineer and maintain integration interfaces, data pipelines, message queues, and event-driven integration workflows across CLIENT's enterprise application portfolio
  • Develop and maintain integration platform configurations, connection management settings, and interface administration procedures
  • Monitor integration platform health, performance, and error rates using Government-provided monitoring tools and dashboards
  • Detect, diagnose, and resolve integration failures, data pipeline errors, and middleware incidents independently for moderately complex issues
  • Escalate complex or cross-domain integration incidents to the Senior Application Operations Engineer or Applications & Integration Lead as appropriate
  • Evaluate integration platform performance and implement engineering improvements that enhance reliability, throughput, and operational efficiency

API Management Engineering:

  • Design, build, and maintain API configurations, policies, and security controls in CLIENT's enterprise API management platform
  • Engineer API gateway configurations, including rate limiting, authentication, authorization, and traffic management policies
  • Develop and maintain API documentation, including endpoint specifications, data schemas, and integration guides
  • Monitor API performance, availability, and security posture, taking proactive action to address issues and prevent service degradation
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex API connectivity, performance, and security issues independently
  • Support API lifecycle management activities, including versioning, deprecation, and retirement of API endpoints
  • Maintain accurate API inventory, endpoint configuration records, and security policy documentation

Middleware Configuration & Administration:

  • Administer and maintain CLIENT's middleware platforms, including message brokers, enterprise service buses, and event streaming platforms as applicable
  • Engineer middleware configurations, including topic management, queue administration, consumer group management, and message routing rules
  • Monitor middleware platform health and performance, taking proactive action to address capacity, performance, and availability issues
  • Support middleware platform upgrades, patching, and version management activities in accordance with ITIL 4 change management practices
  • Develop and maintain middleware administration runbooks, configuration standards, and operational procedures
  • Coordinate with the Infrastructure and Platform Operations team on middleware platform infrastructure requirements and capacity planning

Integration Security Engineering:

  • Engineer integration security configurations aligned with FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, and CLIENT cybersecurity policies
  • Implement secure integration patterns, including encrypted data transmission, certificate management, OAuth 2.0 / SAML authentication, and API security controls
  • Support Zero Trust Architecture implementation across integration platforms in coordination with the Microsoft Infrastructure and Network teams
  • Conduct integration security engineering reviews and provide recommendations for improving CLIENT's integration security posture
  • Manage integration platform certificates, credentials, and secrets in accordance with CLIENT security and key management requirements
  • Support security assessment activities and audit evidence collection for integration platforms and API management services

Cloud Integration Engineering:

  • Engineer and maintain integrations between CLIENT's on-premises systems and cloud environments, including AWS commercial, AWS GovCloud, Microsoft Azure Government, and Microsoft 365
  • Support Azure Integration Services engineering, including Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, and API Management configurations
  • Coordinate with the Microsoft Infrastructure Administrator (Senior) and Infrastructure and Platform Operations team on cloud integration requirements and architecture
  • Engineer and maintain cloud-based data pipeline workflows and event-driven integration patterns
  • Support FedRAMP compliance for cloud-based integration services and API management platforms
  • Maintain accurate cloud integration architecture documentation and configuration records

Integration Testing & Quality Assurance:

  • Develop and execute integration test plans, test cases, and validation procedures for new and modified integration interfaces
  • Conduct integration regression testing to validate that platform changes do not introduce failures or performance degradation
  • Support end-to-end integration testing for application releases and major platform changes
  • Maintain accurate integration test documentation, test results, and defect records in the Government ITSM platform
  • Coordinate with application teams and the Senior Application Operations Engineer on integration test planning and execution
  • Provide integration test results and quality assurance data to support release readiness reviews

Required Qualifications:

Experience:

  • Minimum 4–6 years of hands-on enterprise integration engineering and middleware operations experience
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating enterprise integration platforms and middleware at scale
  • Proven experience with API management platform engineering and API security configuration
  • Experience with data pipeline design and engineering for enterprise application environments
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud integration engineering, including Azure Integration Services or equivalent AWS integration services
  • Experience in a Federal or private-sector enterprise environment of comparable scale, complexity, and security posture
  • Proven ability to independently resolve complex integration and middleware engineering problems
  • Familiarity with FedRAMP-authorized integration platforms and Federal integration security requirements
  • Experience implementing integration security controls aligned with NIST SP 800-53

Technical Expertise:

• Expert-level proficiency in:

  • Enterprise integration platform engineering (e.g., MuleSoft Anypoint, Dell Boomi, Azure Integration Services, IBM MQ, or equivalent)
  • API management platform engineering and security configuration (e.g., Azure API Management, MuleSoft API Gateway, AWS API Gateway)
  • Middleware administration (e.g., message brokers, enterprise service buses, event streaming platforms)
  • Data pipeline design, engineering, and operations
  • Integration security engineering (OAuth 2.0, SAML, TLS/SSL, certificate management)
  • REST and SOAP API design, development, and troubleshooting
  • Cloud integration engineering (Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, AWS EventBridge, or equivalent)

• Strong working knowledge of:

  • Microsoft 365 and Azure Government integration patterns
  • JSON, XML, and data transformation technologies (e.g., XSLT, DataWeave, or equivalent)
  • Integration testing methodologies and tools
  • CI/CD pipeline concepts relevant to integration deployments
  • FedRAMP requirements for cloud-based integration platforms
  • Zero Trust Architecture principles as applied to integration security
  • NIST SP 800-53 security controls for integration platforms
  • ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow)
  • ITIL 4 change, incident, and release management practices
  • Scripting and automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python, or equivalent)

Additional preferred certifications:

  • MuleSoft Certified Developer – Level 1 or Level 2
  • MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Integration Services Specialty
  • AWS Certified Developer – Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience supporting Federal civilian agency enterprise integration environments
  • Familiarity with CLIENT or similar agency integration platforms and application portfolios
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery models in an integration engineering context
  • Experience with event-driven architecture and event streaming platforms (e.g., Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs)

  • Experience supporting FISMA assessment and authorization activities for integration platforms
  • Experience with GraphQL API design and management
  • Experience with containerized integration deployments (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift)

    • Manage multiple projects and collaborate with Corporate Comms, Brand, Social, Field Marketing, Sales, Marketing Ops, and event stakeholders
    • Anticipate risks, resolve roadblocks, and drive alignment to ensure campaigns launch on time

    Performance & Optimization

    • Monitor registration, conversion, attendance, engagement, and channel performance
    • Use data and audience insights to optimize campaigns and recommend improvements
    • Share results, learnings, and recommendations with stakeholders and leadership

    Minimum Qualifications

    • 10+ years of experience in marketing, audience acquisition, or campaign management
    • 8+ years of professional experience writing, editing, and developing marketing and communications content for diverse audiences, including email campaigns, executive communications, presentations, websites, and event marketing assets (i.e. blogs, website, ppt toolkits etc)
    • Experience with Marketo and Salesforce
    • Experience developing and executing integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns across email, web, social, and paid media
    • Experience managing audience-segmented email campaigns, including personalization and localization for global audiences
    • Demonstrated experience managing marketing calendars, campaign roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables for large-scale programs
    • Experience developing campaign frameworks, playbooks, templates, and standardized processes
    • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to execute marketing programs and campaigns
    • Experience using campaign analytics, registration data, and performance metrics to optimize marketing outcomes
    • Hands-on experience with marketing automation, CRM platforms, and campaign analytics tools

    From health and financial benefits to time away and everyday wellness, we give Autodeskers the best, so they can do their best work. Learn more about our benefits in the U.S. by visiting

    Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $103,000 and $183,920. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

    Equal Employment Opportunity

    At Autodesk, we're building a diverse workplace and an inclusive culture to give more people the chance to imagine, design, and make a better world. Autodesk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. We also consider for employment all qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable law.

      <title>Webflow: Senior Infrastructure Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Argentina Remote
</p>

<p>Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.</p>
<h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2>
<p>We’re looking for a <strong>S</strong><strong>enior Infrastructure Engineer </strong>to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.</p>
<ul>
<li>Location: Remote-first (Argentina)</li>
<li>Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)</li>
<li>Application Information:
<ul>
<li>Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled</li>
<li>This posting is for a new position.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>As an <strong>Senior Infrastructure Engineer</strong> you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.</li>
<li>Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.</li>
<li>Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.</li>
<li>Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate,&nbsp; improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.</li>
<li>Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.</li>
<li>Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.</li>
</ul>
<h2>About you&nbsp;</h2>
<p>You’ll thrive as a <strong>Senior Infrastructure Engineer</strong>&nbsp;if you:</p>
<ul>
<li>Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.</li>
<li>Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.</li>
<li>Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.</li>
<li>Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles.</li>
<li>Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.</li>
<li>Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.</li>
</ul>
<p>It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following:</p>
<ul>
<li>Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.</li>
<li>Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana</li>
<li>Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.</li>
<li>Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.</li>
</ul>
<p>You Are:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Collaborative</strong>: You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic thinker</strong>: You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions.</li>
<li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity</strong>: You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements.</li>
</ul>
<p>If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still <strong>seriously consider applying</strong>. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.</p>
<h3><strong>Our Core Behaviors:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Build lasting customer trust.</strong> We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.</li>
<li><strong>Win together.</strong> We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.</li>
<li><strong>Reinvent ourselves. </strong>We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.</li>
<li><strong>Own it all the way. </strong>We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Ownership in what you help build.</strong> Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.</li>
<li><strong>Health coverage that actually covers you.</strong> Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.</li>
<li><strong>Support for every stage of family life</strong>. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.</li>
<li><strong>Time off that’s actually off. </strong>Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.</li>
<li><strong>Wellness for the whole you. </strong>Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.</li>
<li><strong>Invest in your future. </strong>A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Monthly stipends that flex with your life.</strong> Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.</li>
<li><strong>Bonus for building together. </strong>All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.</em></p>
<h3><strong>Remote, together</strong></h3>
<p>At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are <a href="https://webflow.com/diversity-equity-inclusion">committed</a> to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.</p>
<h3><strong>Stay connected</strong></h3>
<p>Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our <a href="https://webflow.com/blog">Webflow Blog</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/webflow-inc-/">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://twitter.com/webflow">X (Twitter)</a>, and/or <a href="https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Webflow-Reviews-E890506.htm">Glassdoor</a>.&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>Please note:</strong></h3>
<p><em>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered.</em></p>
<p><em>To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.</em></p>
<p><em>If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.</em></p>
<p><em>For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review </em><a href="https://webflow.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice"><em>Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice</em></a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/webflow-senior-infrastructure-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/webflow-senior-infrastructure-engineer</a></p>
</description>
