      <title>Wrike: Director, Global GTM Strategy & Operations</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> US - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div>Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>Our vision:&nbsp; </strong>A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div></div><h3>About the Role:</h3>
<p>You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. Collaborative work management is a $14B category growing at 15% a year, and the enterprise competitive set is consolidating fast. Wrike is hiring a Director of Go-To-Market Operations to lead our global GTM Operations team across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.</p>
<p>You will own Wrike’s revenue planning and operational architecture end-to-end driving annual planning, quota setting, territory management, and cross-functional alignment across our global revenue engine.</p>
<p>Reporting directly to GTM leadership, you will serve as a strategic co-pilot to executive leaders while leading a hands-on global team of 6–15 operations partners and analysts.</p>
<p>This is an action-oriented leadership role for an operational "athlete'' - someone equally comfortable steering C-level strategic decisions, designing enterprise sales workflows, coaching an international team across time zones, and diving deep into the details of compensation plans or GTM forecasting.</p>
<h3>Your Impact:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Global Team Leadership: Build, scale, and mentor a global GTM Operations team (15 team members, including embedded business partners and visualization analysts across diverse time zones), fostering a high-performance, team-first culture.</li>
<li>Annual Planning &amp; Execution: Lead annual planning, quota allocation, capacity modeling, and territory design across Sales, CS, and Marketing teams.</li>
<li>Retention &amp; Growth PMO: Partner with executive leadership to program manage company-wide objectives focused on gross/net retention, bookings, and customer lifecycle optimization.</li>
<li>Executive Facilitation: Lead recurring operational cadences with executive stakeholders (Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance, Legal) to eliminate friction and accelerate deal velocity.</li>
<li>Commercial Support &amp; Governance: Oversee non-customer-facing commercial execution, coordinating with Legal, Finance, and Deal Desk to streamline order processing and contracting workflows.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Your Qualifications:</h3>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of progressive experience in Business Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Operations within B2B SaaS.</li>
<li>Proven People Leadership: Direct experience managing and developing global operational teams (6+ direct/indirect reports) across international time zones.</li>
<li>Core GTM Mechanics: Expertise in SaaS unit economics, quota setting, territory planning, retention/bookings metrics, and annual planning processes.</li>
<li>Execution Track Record: High proficiency operating as an executive-level partner to Sales, Marketing, and CS leadership without needing a massive administrative layer.</li>
<li>Location Preference: East Coast U.S. preferred (ability to align with global time zones and executive leadership).</li>
</ul>
<h3>Standout Qualities:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Core Traits: High curiosity (constantly seeking better ways to execute), unyielding commitment to follow-through, and rigorous attention to detail.</li>
<li>Sales Methodology: Familiarity with enterprise value selling frameworks (e.g., Force Management's Command of the Message, MEDDPICC, or Challenger).</li>
<li>Target Background: Experience operating in high-growth, execution-oriented B2B SaaS environments</li>
</ul>
<p>Team Dynamics: You will partner closely with executive leadership and lead a global team of GTM business partners and data visualization specialists. Your team acts as the central nerve center connecting field execution with executive strategy.</p>
<p>Our Work Style: We run Wrike on Wrike. You will use our collaborative work management platform daily to run annual planning, manage operational portfolios, and track team execution. We value intellectual curiosity, data-backed decision-making, and swift cross-functional execution.</p>
<h3><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Flexible Time Off (FTO)</li>
<li>Company 401(k) Match</li>
<li>Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity&nbsp;</li>
<li>2 Volunteer Days</li>
<li>Health (medical, dental &amp; vision) Insurance (EEs + Dependents)</li>
<li>Disability (STD, LTD) &amp; Life Insurance Plans (2x Salary, Capped)</li>
<li>Working from Home Allowance ($40 / Monthly)</li>
<li>$500 Working from Home home office set-up Stipend</li>
</ul>
<p>Your recruitment buddy will be&nbsp;<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/azizatalhi/"><span class="s1">Aziza Talhi</span></a>, Senior Recruiter.</p>
<p>&nbsp;#LI-AT1</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The range below reflects the total on-target earnings (including base salary and performance-based bonus potential) for this full-time position and applies to all U.S. locations, excluding benefits and other incentives. The final offer within this range will consider factors such as the role, seniority level, geographic location, and employment contract type. An individual’s work location, unique skills, experience, and relevant educational background will also influence the final offer. For tailored compensation details based on your preferred location, please discuss with your recruiter during the hiring process.</em></p></div><div class="title">Total compensation pay range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$180,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$205,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>Who Is Wrike and Our Culture</strong></h3>
<div>We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div><strong>Hybrid work mode</strong></div>
<div><br>
<div>
<div>Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h4><strong>Our persona&nbsp;</strong></h4>
<div><strong>&nbsp; Smart:</strong> We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.</div>
<div><strong>&nbsp; Dedicated: </strong>We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!</div>
<div><strong>&nbsp; Approachable:</strong> We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.&nbsp;</div>
<h4><strong>Our culture and Values&nbsp;</strong></h4>
<p><strong> Customer-Focused</strong></p>
<p><strong>We care about our customers. </strong>We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.</p>
<p><strong> Collaborative</strong></p>
<p><strong>We work as one and win together, </strong>each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.</p>
<p><strong> Creative</strong></p>
<p><strong>We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. </strong>It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong> Committed</strong></p>
<p><strong>We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, </strong>by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.</p>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div>Check out our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/wrike/life/3fd588bf-73e8-47be-9b0a-1933d404ea88/">LinkedIn Life Page</a>, <a href="https://www.wrike.com/wrike-company-culture/">Company culture page</a>, <a href="https://www.instagram.com/wriketeam">Instagram</a>, <a href="https://www.wrike.com/wrike-engineering/">Wrike Engineering Team</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://medium.com/wriketechclub">Medium</a>, <a href="https://www.meetup.com/WrikeTechClub/?_cookie-check=wtgfN9ARYGPSGd3e">Meetup.com</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/wriketechclub">Youtube</a> for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<p><a href="https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Wrike-EI_IE420969.11,16.htm"><img src="https://www.glassdoor.com/pc-app/static/img/partnerCenter/badges/eng_CHECK_US_273x90.png" alt="Check us out on Glassdoor."></a></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-director-global-gtm-strategy-operations">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-director-global-gtm-strategy-operations</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Stripe: Abuse Research Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote from the US
</p>

<h2>Who we are</h2>
<h3>About Stripe</h3>
<p><span>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p>
<h3>About the team</h3>
<p>Abuse Research Group (ARG) handles proactive threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis across Stripe products. Rather than reacting to alerts, the team maps end-to-end fraud and abuse paths, validates novel attack vectors, and identifies product conditions that enable fraud. Using agentic automated testing and simulation tools, ARG translates research into actionable threat advisories, strategic control recommendations, and regression scenarios to systematically eliminate vulnerabilities.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<p>As an Abuse Research Engineer in the Abuse Research Group, you will play a critical role in safeguarding Stripe’s financial ecosystem by proactively hunting for advanced threats, dissecting complex fraud vectors, and extracting actionable adversary intelligence. &nbsp;Rather than relying solely on reactive alerts, you will develop and execute hypothesis-driven threat hunting operations across internal telemetry and external sources to uncover fraudulent tools, tactics, and techniques (TTPs) before they impact Stripe’s platform. Central to this work is FT3 (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0), Stripe’s multi-layered taxonomy that decomposes monolithic fraud into structured kill chains. &nbsp;Collaborating cross-functionally with Fraud Ops, Strategy, Risk, Onboarding, and Security, you will integrate threat intelligence, build agentic simulation workflows, and systematically eliminate product vulnerabilities.</p>
<h3>Responsibilities</h3>
<ul>
<li>Proactive Threat Hunting &amp; Kill Chain Analysis: Formulate hypotheses and conduct iterative threat hunting operations across Stripe systems and external data.</li>
<li>FT3 Taxonomy: Apply and enrich the FT3 framework across empirical datasets and incidents, standardizing threat intelligence across kill chain phases and targeted API endpoints. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Threat Intelligence &amp; Signal Expansion: Partner with teams like Fraud Intelligence to integrate, curate, and automate threat feeds into engineering workflows. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Cross-Functional Advisories &amp; Strategic Controls: Translate raw research and retrospective findings into actionable threat advisories and control recommendations (policy, technical systems, support workflows, and detection mechanisms) for stakeholders across Fraud, Risk, Onboarding, and Security. &nbsp;</li>
<li>Agentic Testing &amp; Adversary Simulation: Utilize agentic automated testing frameworks to simulate adversary TTPs, validate whether deployed controls interrupt empirical kill chains, and generate regression scenarios to exercise controls. &nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2>
<p><span>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</span></p>
<h3>Minimum requirements</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience conducting threat intelligence, threat hunting, or technical incident response within cyber security, product abuse, or trust domains.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>5+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets using data analytics tools to identify anomalies, map behavioral trends, and solve complex fraud problems.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated experience using code and scripting to automate workflows, build investigative tools, or query big data pipelines.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Hands-on experience in log analysis (e.g., application logs, API route telemetry, network security events), digital forensics, and cyber investigation methodologies.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Strong communication skills with a proven ability to translate complex technical research into clear, actionable recommendations and advisories for cross-functional partners.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Deep technical understanding of threat actor motivations, infrastructure, and TTPs specific to financial fraud (e.g., ATO, Card Testing, Credential Stuffing).&nbsp;</li>
<li>Familiarity with standardized taxonomies such as FT3 or MITRE ATT&amp;CK.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proficiency with engineering, data processing, and analysis platforms such as Databricks, Trino, PySpark, Pandas, or Scikit-Learn.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proven background utilizing Threat Intelligence Platforms (TIPs), tactical threat feeds, OSINT, and breach intelligence.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated capability building or leveraging agentic LLM tools, automated testing systems, or control validation frameworks to model adversary behavior at scale.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Participation in industry conferences, webinars, or threat-sharing groups, alongside relevant professional certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA, OSCP).</li>
</ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)
</p>

<h3><strong>Commercial Data Scientist</strong></h3>
<p>Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.&nbsp;</p>
<p>At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
<p><br><em>This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S.</em></p>
<p><strong>As a Commercial Data Scientist</strong>, you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.</li>
<li>Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights &amp; Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.</li>
<li>Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects.</li>
<li>Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.</li>
<li>Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<p><strong>As an organization we value diversity - </strong>in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Collaboration</strong>—The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.</li>
<li><strong>Passion for Data</strong>—You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.</li>
<li><strong>Reliability</strong> – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.</li>
<li><strong>Curiosity</strong> – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.</li>
<li><strong>Respect</strong> – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About you:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>At least <strong>4 years</strong> of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets.</li>
<li>Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment</li>
<li>Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques</li>
<li>Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.</li>
<li>Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships.</li>
<li>Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.</li>
<li>Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.</li>
<li>Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Fun</strong> <strong>Facts About the Client Intelligence team</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.</li>
<li>Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.</li>
<li>The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.</li>
<li>We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p>The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.</p>
<p>Our total compensation package may include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Base salary</li>
<li>Equity (where applicable)</li>
<li>Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<p>In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance</li>
<li>401(k) with company match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off and company holidays</li>
<li>Paid parental leave</li>
<li>Professional development and learning opportunities</li>
<li>Wellness and mental health resources</li>
<li>Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Why You'll Love Working Here</strong></p>
<p>At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Make a real impact.</strong> Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.</li>
<li><strong>Work with exceptional teammates.</strong> Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.</li>
<li><strong>Enjoy flexibility and trust.</strong> We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.</li>
<li><strong>Grow your career.</strong> Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.</li>
<li><strong>Bring your authentic self.</strong> We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Our Hiring Process &amp; AI Tools</strong></p>
<p>Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity</strong></p>
<p><em>Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</em></p>
<p><em>If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.</em></p>

<p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>Hex’s legal function has gone from zero to a fully operating system in under a year. Now we need someone to own and scale the operating layer so it holds as the company grows. <strong>This is a builder role.</strong></p>
<p>You’ll run contract operations end to end: CLM administration, workflow optimization, template and playbook maintenance, enablement and training for the revenue team, and first-pass review and redlining of standard agreements against our playbook. Beyond contracts, you’ll build structured intake for every legal workstream across the company, own the legal governance record (privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars), manage outside counsel relationships, and own the legal tech stack. We sit at the nexus of data, AI, and collaboration, which means our legal operations have to be as thoughtful as our product.</p>
<p>We use AI tooling across legal operations, and you’ll work the same way: building agents and automations to move faster, not as a side project but as the default way things get done here. If you see a manual workflow and instinctively want to build it away, you’ll feel right at home.</p>
<p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive CLM adoption and enablement so the revenue team self-serves on standard deals</li>
<li>Own workflow optimization, templates, and playbooks as deal structures and products evolve</li>
<li>First-pass review and redlining of standard agreements; draft from templates as volume requires</li>
<li>Build and own structured intake for legal workstreams across the company</li>
<li>Build AI-powered workflows, agents, and automations that replace manual processes</li>
<li>Maintain the legal governance record: privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars</li>
<li>Train cross-functional teams on self-service tools and escalation paths</li>
<li>Manage outside counsel relationships and the legal tech stack</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About You:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3-5+ years in legal operations, paralegal, or contract management, with at least 1-2 years in-house at a tech or SaaS company</li>
<li>You’ve implemented or rebuilt a CLM (Ironclad preferred), designed intake workflows, and stood up reporting someone relied on</li>
<li>Experience reviewing and redlining commercial agreements on both sell-side and buy-side paper</li>
<li>You build with AI and automation as a natural part of how you work. You’re comfortable across AI-assisted legal tools, LLMs, and automation platforms, and willing to experiment with new ones as they emerge. This isn’t a nice-to-have at Hex.</li>
<li>Comfortable operating with autonomy in a role with a lot of white space</li>
<li>Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs a lawyer</li>
<li>You care whether people actually use what you build</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Nice to have:</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a company navigating exponential growth</li>
<li>Experience with corporate governance (entity management, board materials, annual filings)</li>
<li>Has used Hex</li>
<li>Strong opinions about the best way to organize a Notion workspace</li>
</ul>
<p>We know job posts like this can feel like a checklist, and nobody checks every box. If you’ve built legal ops infrastructure, you’re excited about AI, and this role sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we’d love to hear from you.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<p>In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary &amp; equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.</p>
<p>The salary range for this role is: $124,125 - $165,500.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness &amp; parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.</p>
<p>By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy:&nbsp;<span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-754370997"><a href="https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy">https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy</a></span>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our <strong>team </strong>evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output.</p></div>

      <title>Lithic: Senior Risk Associate</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a Senior Risk Associate to run Lithic's risk assessment function: the client risk assessment program, the third party risk management program, and the enterprise risk assessment. You will execute the assessments, own the operations that keep them on schedule and defensible, and continuously improve the rubrics, questionnaires, registers, and SOPs that govern them. You will also own program underwriting: the criteria, limit and reserve recommendations, and periodic reassessment that follow a client from diligence through scale.</p>
<p>This is an AI-forward role. Lithic is deploying agentic tooling across diligence and documentation workflows, and this role owns that build in the assessment domain: testing, tuning, and documenting the tooling so routine collection, review, and drafting are absorbed by automation, while you own the judgment calls, the exceptions, and the written product that goes to partner banks and examiners.</p>
<p>This role operates with limited guidance and owns its programs end to end. It is sized for ownership, orchestration, and judgment rather than queue/ticket processing.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Execute client risk assessments end to end: document collection, interviews, scoring against the weighted risk typologies, written assessment, tier determination, and pre-launch conditions.</li>
<li>Own program underwriting: apply and maintain underwriting criteria, recommend spend, transfer, and reserve limits, and reassess programs as volume, product mix, and financial condition change.</li>
<li>Run third party risk operations: vendor intake and tiering, due diligence and certification report review, control effectiveness ratings, the vendor risk register, annual reviews, and vendor issue and incident tracking.</li>
<li>Support the enterprise risk assessment and the risk register: maintain the assessment inventory and calendar, collect and test control evidence, apply the enterprise rating methodology consistently across sub-assessments, and prepare Enterprise Risk Committee materials.</li>
<li>Continuously improve the programs: refine rubrics, weights, questionnaires, and templates based on observed outcomes, and author and maintain the SOPs that make each assessment repeatable by someone other than you.</li>
<li>Test, deploy, and tune agentic tooling across the assessment workflows, including document review, questionnaire analysis, vendor due diligence, and drafting, and document the context that makes the output repeatable and defensible.</li>
<li>Define and report the KPIs and KRIs for the assessment programs, and surface concentration, trend, and thematic findings to leadership and oversight forums.</li>
<li>Serve as the evidence owner for partner bank, audit, and examiner requests touching client, third party, and enterprise risk assessment.</li>
<li>Mentor and cross-train teammates on assessment methodology, scoring discipline, and the tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Hands-on experience conducting risk assessments in fintech, payments, or banking, across client or counterparty, third party or vendor, and enterprise or operational risk.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of underwriting fundamentals: financial statement review, liquidity and runway analysis, loss and exposure monitoring, and limit setting.</li>
<li>Fluency with rubric-based scoring methodologies and the discipline to apply them consistently and defend a rating.</li>
<li>A track record of owning discrete risk programs end to end with limited guidance, including authoring the SOPs and defining the metrics that govern them.</li>
<li>Ability to read control reports (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS AOC) and translate findings into a residual risk position and a remediation ask.</li>
<li>Comfort working with AI-assisted or agentic tooling, including how to test, tune, document, and defend AI-assisted decisions to bank partners and regulators</li>
<li>Self-starter who can create structure where none exists and knows when to escalate and collaborate</li>
<li>Clear, concise writing under a compliance standard: assessments, memos, and committee materials that hold up in front of a partner bank or an examiner.</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual US salary range for this role is <span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-3d77e89a-8e74-80c6-adbd-001cb1e28a1e notion-enable-hover">$86,000 - $144,000,</span> plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Benefits for Full-Time US Employees:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Unlimited PTO</li>
<li>12-weeks fully paid parental leave</li>
<li>4-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5-year anniversary)</li>
<li>Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4-weeks each year</li>
<li>3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary <a href="http://Privacy.com">Privacy.com</a> employee account</li>
<li>Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match</li>
<li>401(k) match</li>
<li>Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD</li>
</ul>
<p>NYC-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs.</p>
<p>In-office employees receive:&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>Commuter benefit</li>
<li>Catered lunch every Tuesday and Thursday</li>
</ul></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lithic-senior-risk-associate">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lithic-senior-risk-associate</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Salesloft: Principal Software Engineer, AI</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><span><strong>Job Title:</strong> Principal Software Engineer, AI&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Location</strong>: Remote - US</span></p>
<p>Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.</p>
<p>With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.</p>
<p>Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.</p>
<p>This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.</li>
<li>Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.</li>
<li>Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.</li>
<li>Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.</li>
<li>Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.</li>
<li>Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.</li>
</ul>
<p>This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.</p>
<p>You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.</p>
<p>This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.</p>
<p><strong>THE TEAM</strong></p>
<p>The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.</p>
<p>The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.</li>
<li>Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.</li>
<li>Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.</li>
<li>A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.</li>
<li>Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.</li>
<li>Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>BENEFITS:</strong></p>
<p>For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit: https://salesloftbenefits.com/</p>
<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!</p>
<p>Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from&nbsp;@ <a href="http://salesloft.com">salesloft.com</a> email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official <a href="https://salesloft.com/company/careers/">Careers Page</a>.</p>
<p><em>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.</em></p>
<p>#LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.&nbsp; The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.</p>
<p>The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$165,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$185,000 USD</span></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-principal-software-engineer-ai">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-principal-software-engineer-ai</a></p>

<p>

</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply.&nbsp;<em>Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. </em><em>We encourage you to help us break that statistic!</em></p>
<p><strong>About Tailscale&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.</p></div><h3><span>About the Role</span></h3>
<p>We are looking for an Analytics Engineer who thrives in high-complexity environments—someone excited to bring clarity to chaos, untangle complex models, and lay down the foundation for scalable solutions.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who isn’t afraid to address manual processes, viewing them as opportunities to build scalable solutions that drive meaningful impact. You’ll work closely with stakeholders across the company to build reliable, trusted data models that support reporting, analysis, and decision-making.</p>
<h3><span>Key Responsibilities</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Dive into complex systems and manual workflows to develop an understanding of our tools and constraints.</li>
<li>Thoughtfully design and maintain clean, scalable, production-grade dbt models (e.g., ARR, revenue recognition).</li>
<li>Work across the full data pipeline, from ingestion to transformation to visualization.</li>
<li>Take a pragmatic approach to system challenges, balancing quick fixes with thoughtful long-term design.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Finance, Engineering, Sales, and other teams across the company to understand data needs and deliver timely, practical solutions.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>What We Are Looking For</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience designing and maintaining production-grade data models and pipelines.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern data modeling principles and best practices.</li>
<li>Strong SQL skills and confidence working with complex datasets and schemas.</li>
<li>High attention to detail, with high standards for data accuracy and validation.</li>
<li>Flexibility and resourcefulness in navigating manual tasks or imperfect systems.</li>
<li>Passion for clean code, scalable architecture, and incrementally reducing complexity over time.</li>
<li>Ability to manage time, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.</li>
<li>Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical collaborators.</li>
<li>Willingness to flexibly support other domains (e.g., Product, Marketing, and Engineering) as the team grows.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Nice to Have</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a high-growth PLG SaaS company.</li>
<li>A track record of transforming manual, ad hoc workflows into scalable data pipelines.</li>
<li>Familiarity with billing systems, GAAP accounting, revenue recognition, or audit support.</li>
<li>Exposure to Stripe, Salesforce, or Orb in billing and finance contexts.</li>
<li>Familiarity with financial cycles and the need for fast iteration during month- and quarter-end.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Our Tech Stack</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Snowflake, dbt, Hightouch, Fivetran, Looker, Stripe, Salesforce, Orb.</li>
</ul>
<p>As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">CAN Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$203,680</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$254,600 CAD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self.</strong> We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.</li>
<li><strong>A competitive total compensation package.</strong> This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).</li>
<li><strong>Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. </strong>Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!</li>
<li><strong>Remote first company</strong>—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.</li>
<li><strong>Employer-funded retirement contributions. </strong>Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.</li>
<li><strong>Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. </strong>Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.<strong><br></strong></li>
<li><strong>Support for your personal and professional development.</strong> Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration.&nbsp;</strong>Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>A build-your-own home office setup. </strong>You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Paid parental leave program</strong>. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).</li>
</ul>

For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit <a href="https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness">https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness</a>.</em></p></div>

You’ll work closely with stakeholders across the company to build reliable, trusted data models that support reporting, analysis, and decision-making.</p>
<h3><span>Key Responsibilities</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Dive into complex systems and manual workflows to develop an understanding of our tools and constraints.</li>
<li>Thoughtfully design and maintain clean, scalable, production-grade dbt models (e.g., ARR, revenue recognition).</li>
<li>Work across the full data pipeline, from ingestion to transformation to visualization.</li>
<li>Take a pragmatic approach to system challenges, balancing quick fixes with thoughtful long-term design.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Finance, Engineering, Sales, and other teams across the company to understand data needs and deliver timely, practical solutions.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>What We Are Looking For</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience designing and maintaining production-grade data models and pipelines.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern data modeling principles and best practices.</li>
<li>Strong SQL skills and confidence working with complex datasets and schemas.</li>
<li>High attention to detail, with high standards for data accuracy and validation.</li>
<li>Flexibility and resourcefulness in navigating manual tasks or imperfect systems.</li>
<li>Passion for clean code, scalable architecture, and incrementally reducing complexity over time.</li>
<li>Ability to manage time, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.</li>
<li>Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical collaborators.</li>
<li>Willingness to flexibly support other domains (e.g., Product, Marketing, and Engineering) as the team grows.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Nice to Have</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a high-growth PLG SaaS company.</li>
<li>A track record of transforming manual, ad hoc workflows into scalable data pipelines.</li>
<li>Familiarity with billing systems, GAAP accounting, revenue recognition, or audit support.</li>
<li>Exposure to Stripe, Salesforce, or Orb in billing and finance contexts.</li>
<li>Familiarity with financial cycles and the need for fast iteration during month- and quarter-end.</li>

<p>

</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for Lithic’s Card Authorization team, which owns the real-time systems that make every card authorization decision correct, reliable, and fast. The team also owns related fraud tooling, including Lithic’s Rules Engine and 3D Secure integration. You’ll own high-impact projects end-to-end, solve distributed-systems problems at scale, and help build the tools customers use to control fraud and payment risk.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Write reliable, secure, scalable code for Lithic’s real-time authorization and fraud-prevention systems with minimal tech debt</li>
<li>Build customer-facing features, such as rules improvements, velocity controls, 3DS flows, fraud tooling, and transaction monitoring. Own projects from planning to launch.</li>
<li>Improve the reliability of systems in team’s scope and participate in the team on-call rotation</li>
<li>Lead efforts to improve systems and processes within the team</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>4+ years building production backend systems. Full stack experience is a plus.</li>
<li>Experience in or desire to learn Rust; ability to understand Lithic’s system written in other programming languages (Python, Java)</li>
<li>Interest and experience in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity</li>
<li>Ability to navigate ambiguity, align diverse perspectives, and drive toward practical solutions</li>
<li>Experience or interest in payments, fintech, fraud prevention.</li>
<li>Comfort with designing systems from scratch and owning the product development process end-to-end</li>
<li>Strong written communication skills and experience working in a remote, async-first team that’s spread across time zones</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 to $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.</p>

      <title>Discord: Engineering Manager, Machine Learning (Safety)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco Bay Area (or Remote U.S.)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: <strong>play video games.</strong> Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.</p></div><p>Discord's Safety ML team builds the machine learning systems that protect 200M+ users. The team's mission is to make Discord a place where people can build genuine friendships without exposure to harm, at a scale where manual review alone can never keep up.</p>
<p>We're looking for a highly technical, hands-on, and mission-driven Engineering Manager to lead our Safety ML team. As the manager responsible for Safety ML, you will own the detection systems that sit between attackers and our users; real-time and batch models for content understanding, account integrity, and platform abuse.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build and lead an exceptional team of highly-engaged ML engineers by hiring, coaching, and instilling a sense of ownership and impact.</li>
<li>Drive the technical vision and roadmap for Safety ML by collaborating with your team and partners across Trust &amp; Safety, Product, Policy, Legal, and Data Science.</li>
<li>Own the end-to-end lifecycle of production safety models: defining new capabilities, measuring performance, and monitoring the operational health of systems that make millions of enforcement decisions per day.</li>
<li>Manage processes and leverage your technical expertise to continually raise the bar and ensure your team delivers extraordinary results.</li>
<li>Partner with Trust &amp; Safety on label quality, golden sets, and automating manual investigations.</li>
<li>Work with other Engineering Managers to continuously improve the Engineering organization and uphold our <a href="https://blog.discordapp.com/the-four-values-of-working-at-discord-90d5b5102cbc">workplace philosophy</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you should have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You have 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, or Applied Scientist.</li>
<li>You have 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager and successfully managed a team of 5+ engineers.</li>
<li>You have hands-on depth in at least one of: abuse/fraud detection, content classification, behavioral modeling, graph-based modeling, or LLM-based classification systems.</li>
<li>You have strong communication skills and the ability to work well cross-functionally.</li>
<li>You thrive in ambiguous environments and get excited about figuring out solutions to complex problems, and then executing on them.</li>
<li>You are a first principles thinker that can work with others to come up with pragmatic solutions.</li>
<li>You have a proven record of shipping ML systems to production at scale.</li>
<li>You are passionate about coaching and leading other engineers, but can roll up your sleeves and get elbow deep in code when needed.</li>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Bethesda, Maryland, United States; Remote-US-MA; Remote-US-MD; Remote-US-WA; Vancouver, Washington, United States; Waltham, Massachusetts, United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.</p></div><div>
<p class="markdown-p">You'll lead the team that builds the intelligence every ZoomInfo AI agent reasons over — what's true about companies and the people in them, how they relate, and what they're buying. This role owns the B2B data graph strategy end to end, blending classical machine learning and data science with LLM and agentic systems, and treating evaluation and inference cost as core disciplines. You'll set the technical bar for a team of senior engineers while staying close to the code, shipping alongside the people you lead.</p>
<p class="markdown-p"><strong class="markdown-strong">What You'll Do</strong></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You will ship code alongside your team, prototype alone to prove or kill an idea, and review code as a peer, setting how the team uses agentic coding tools with precise specifications and rigorous review.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will own delivery end-to-end, from problem framing through serving and on-call, including long-tail graph coverage and user memory for agents that separates user-supplied context from system-of-record data.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will choose the right method for each problem — classical machine learning, language models, or code — for challenges like sparse-company revenue estimation, entity resolution, and semantic intent modeling, deciding on measured evidence and stopping work that won't pay off.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will define what it takes to claim an agent's output is correct, not just that its run completed, building the evaluation datasets, regression gates, and experiment designs that back those claims.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will own inference cost, latency, and capacity, including build-versus-buy and distillation decisions, since a model too expensive to run everywhere isn't a result.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will hire and grow machine learning engineers, data scientists, and research engineers, developing senior engineers into technical leaders.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will work across product, platform, security, and legal, and present results and their limits to executives, including when a system isn't good enough to launch.</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p"><strong class="markdown-strong">What You Bring</strong></p>
<p class="markdown-p"><em class="markdown-em">Must-Have:</em></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You have significant experience building production machine learning systems and leading the engineers who build them by shipping alongside them — demonstrated capability matters more than years.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have a track record of hiring and developing senior machine learning engineers and data scientists against a high bar.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You stay hands-on today: shipping code, building prototypes independently, and using agentic coding tools daily with rigorous review.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You bring deep classical machine learning and data science expertise (supervised learning, feature engineering, statistical inference and experiment design, strong SQL) alongside production LLM and agentic systems, with the judgment to choose between them, including setting an evaluation bar with leakage-safe validation, calibration, and validated LLM judges.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have a record of cost and capacity decisions for model serving, such as moving a workload from a hosted model to a distilled or self-hosted one, with the savings measured, and you report results to executives with their limits stated, including recommending against a launch.</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p"><em class="markdown-em">Preferred:</em></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You bring entrepreneurial experience — founding a company, or taking a product from inception to paying customers as a founding or early engineer.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have experience in propensity modeling, ranking and retrieval, clustering, or entity resolution at scale.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have worked on web-scale language processing over multilingual, noisy text, knowledge graphs, or user memory for agents.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have experience with post-training and distillation, open-weight model serving, or AI governance and safety practices (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF).</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="markdown-p">#LI-hybrid</p>
<p class="markdown-p">#LI-VC1</p>
</div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific salary range for your desired work location during the hiring process. We want our employees and their families to thrive.</p>
<p>In addition to comprehensive benefits we offer holistic mind, body and lifestyle programs designed for overall well-being. Learn more about ZoomInfo benefits <a class="c-link" href="https://www.zoominfo.com/careers#benefits">here</a>.</p></div><div class="title">Below is the US base salary for this position. Additional compensation such as Bonus, Commission, Equity and other benefits may also apply.</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$233,100</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$366,300 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About us:</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<p>ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) is the Go-To-Market Intelligence Platform that empowers businesses to grow faster with AI-ready insights, trusted data, and advanced automation. Its solutions provide more than 35,000 companies worldwide with a complete view of their customers, making every seller their best seller.</p>
<p>ZoomInfo is committed to protecting your privacy when you apply for jobs with us. Please review our Job Applicant <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yiG-k0YX_sW10PiJk_xliDc3W-veJCrK/view?usp=drive_link">Privacy Notice</a> for more details on how we handle your personal information.</p>

<p>ZoomInfo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and does not discriminate based on protected status. We also consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in accordance with legal requirements.</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Portugal - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>In this role you will get opportunities to implement and maintain CI/CD systems and developer productivity solutions. You will be responsible for both regularly scheduled work as well as on-demand break-fix work to support Dremio’s CI/CD system, identifying areas of improvement, and implementing changes to increase efficiency and effectiveness of those systems.</p>
<p>Bring your industry experience to improve the efficiency and scale of Dremio’s infrastructure via innovation on tooling and methodologies. You should have empathy for developers and a passion for engineering productivity.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Solve problems for fellow Dremio engineers by:</li>
<ul>
<li>Leveraging and contributing to playbooks to implement solutions to unblock them</li>
<li>Identifying short term workarounds and documenting them</li>
<li>Automating processes where manual processes exist.</li>
</ul>
<li>Working on infrastructure across all major clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).</li>
<li>Managing access to key infrastructure.</li>
<li>Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and associated systems to increase organizational efficiency.</li>
<li>Automate local development workflows.</li>
<li>Analyze performance bottlenecks, root cause issues, file defects, follow up with developers, and document resolutions.</li>
<li>Clear focus on keeping our development branches ‘green’.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Release engineering - automating processes to push software to delivery endpoints.</li>
<li>Report out on the status, reliability and robustness of our CI/CD systems.</li>
<li>Actively participate in code reviews.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>B.S. or M.S in Computer Science or in a related technical field</li>
<li>1+ years of experience on large scale distributed systems</li>
<li>Comfortable navigating the fast moving, unstructured nature of a hyper-growth startup.</li>
<li>Demonstrable Knowledge and Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP)</li>

      <title>Dremio: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Query Execution</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Portugal - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, owning the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution.</p>
<p>As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you’ll work on query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and performance optimization. Your work will directly affect query performance, scalability, and reliability across Dremio’s cloud data platform.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build the execution engine: Design, implement, test, and support query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and resource management.</li>
<li>Improve runtime performance: Optimize vectorized processing, concurrency, parallelism, memory usage, data exchange, and disk spilling.</li>
<li>Diagnose difficult problems: Investigate query correctness and performance issues using query profiles, profiling tools, telemetry, benchmarks, logs, and production data.</li>
<li>Optimize Java and the JVM: Improve CPU utilization, allocation behavior, garbage collection, thread behavior, and other runtime characteristics.</li>
<li>Collaborate across the query engine: Work with Query Planner, Datalake, Product, Support, and field engineering teams on end-to-end query improvements.</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, documentation, and incident analysis.</li>
<li>Apply engineering judgment: Validate AI-generated code and recommendations through review, testing, benchmarking, and engineering judgment.</li>
<li>Raise the engineering bar: Participate in design and code reviews, contribute to technical direction, and mentor other engineers.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Software engineering experience: 5+ years developing production software, preferably in database systems, query execution, distributed systems, or related areas.</li>
<li>Programming skills: Strong Java skills; experience with C++ is a plus.</li>
<li>Computer science fundamentals: Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, multithreaded programming, and asynchronous programming.</li>
<li>Database and distributed systems knowledge: Understanding of database internals, query processing, distributed execution, and performance optimization.</li>
<li>Performance engineering experience: Experience profiling and optimizing CPU, memory, garbage collection, thread behavior, or other runtime characteristics.</li>
<li>Problem-solving ability: Ability to solve ambiguous technical problems and work effectively across team boundaries.</li>
<li>Engineering judgment: Ability to evaluate tradeoffs, validate solutions rigorously, and make sound decisions when working with unfamiliar or AI-assisted implementations.</li>
<li>Communication and ownership: Strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality software.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Query engines: Distributed query engines, database engines, or large-scale data processing systems.</li>
<li>Execution techniques: Vectorized execution, query operators, expression evaluation, code generation, or runtime optimization.</li>
<li>Runtime systems: JVM profiling, memory management, caching, networking, data exchange, execution scheduling, or disk spilling.</li>
<li>Data platforms: Apache Arrow, Apache Iceberg, Parquet, Avro, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores.</li>
<li>Open source: Contributing to open-source projects.</li>
